sentences.l2: 近年来，“996”逐渐从个别企业的内部规定，演变成一种被默认接受的行业惯例。
sentences.l1: In recent years, "996" has gradually evolved from the internal rules of individual companies into an industry convention that is accepted by default.

sentences.l2: 每天早九点上班、晚九点下班、每周工作六天，长时间加班被包装成“奋斗”的美德，甚至成了衡量员工是否忠诚的隐性标准。
sentences.l1: With work starting at nine every morning, ending at nine every night, and running six days a week, long overtime is packaged as the virtue of "striving", and has even become an implicit standard for measuring whether employees are loyal.

sentences.l2: 在这样的环境里，同事们不得不相互比较谁走得更晚，于是出现了“内卷”的现象：投入的时间越来越多，最终的回报却几乎没有增加。
sentences.l1: In such an environment, colleagues cannot help comparing with one another who leaves later, and so the phenomenon of "involution" appears: ever more time is invested, yet the final returns have hardly increased.

sentences.l2: 面对这种消耗，一部分年轻人选择“躺平”，用降低欲望、拒绝竞争的方式保护自己的生活；另一部分人则把《劳动法》当作武器，通过仲裁和诉讼要求企业支付加班费。
sentences.l1: Faced with this kind of drain, some young people choose to "lie flat", protecting their lives by lowering their desires and refusing to compete; others take the Labor Law as a weapon, and demand through arbitration and litigation that companies pay overtime wages.

sentences.l2: 法律明确规定了每日和每月加班的上限，但在实际执行中，取证困难、担心失业等因素让许多人望而却步。
sentences.l1: The law clearly stipulates upper limits on daily and monthly overtime, but in actual enforcement, factors such as the difficulty of gathering evidence and the fear of unemployment make many people hesitate.

sentences.l2: 真正的改变，或许不在于个人的忍耐或逃避，而在于让规则重新回到谈判桌上。
sentences.l1: Real change perhaps lies not in individual endurance or escape, but in bringing the rules back to the negotiating table.
